title: Six Reflections on Shri Rama: A Devotional and Interpretive Essay
summary: Devotion to Shri Rama is often presented as a single, undifferentiated whole, with little attention to how its practices, narratives, metaphysics and ethics relate to one another or to the scriptural sources on which they rest. This essay addresses that problem through six linked reflections that move from the personal to the public: the Divine Name, devotional service, community, the epic narrative, ultimate reality, and just rule. It adopts an interpretive, devotional-hermeneutic approach. Primary texts, namely the Valmiki Ramayana, the Ramcharitmanas, the Adhyatma Ramayana, the Upanishads…

review.reason: Offers an interpretive, textually grounded analysis of devotional themes in the Rama tradition.
